# Kanto

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Kanto has 36 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from FireRed and LeafGreen (both versions).

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges.

#### Gym 1: Brock (Pewter) -- the Boulder Badge
Rock specialist. 2 Pokemon, best level 14: your team fights at level 14 at most, and on hard you bring 2 at most. Prize money: $700 on easy, $1,400 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Geodude | Rock/Ground | 12 | Bulldoze, Rock Throw, Tackle, Harden |
| Onix | Rock/Ground | 14 | Bulldoze, Rock Tomb, Rock Throw, Tackle |

**Hit them with** Steel, Ground, Fighting moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Ground, Rock. **Careful with** Fire Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Tested team:** Psyduck, Slowpoke, Mankey, Butterfree, Beedrill, Pikachu. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Kanto by this point, raised to level 14 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 2).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).

#### Elite Four, seat 1: Lorelei
Ice specialist. 5 Pokemon, best level 54: your team fights at level 54 at most, and on hard you bring 5 at most. Prize money: $2,700 on easy, $5,400 on hard (half again for a rematch).
